about.heading: No directory. No swipe deck. No automated match claim.

principles.title: Context before names
principles.body: Lane starts from goals, constraints, timing, and mutual usefulness.

principles.title: A private pass stays private
principles.body: Either person can decline without a reason being exposed to the other.

principles.title: Double opt-in
principles.body: Contact details and meeting specifics appear only after both people agree.

about.scopeNote: Lane supports founder–investor, founder–co-founder, and startup–startup introductions for the configured event.

process.heading: A short brief. One proposal. Both people choose.
process.body: The interface helps Lane collect and organize context; a human remains responsible for review, proposal, and consent.

steps.title: Connect after two yeses
steps.body: Only mutual consent unlocks contact details and meeting coordination.

faq.heading: Questions before you share a brief.

items.question: Does Lane show me a list of people?
items.answer: No. Lane supports one human-reviewed proposal at a time and never exposes the participant pool.

items.question: Is the matching automated?
items.answer: No. The software organizes context, but a human operator reviews fit and controls proposals.

items.question: Can I decline privately?
items.answer: Yes. A pass remains private and does not reveal a reason to the proposed counterpart.

items.question: When are contact details shared?
items.answer: Only after both people explicitly opt in to the same introduction.

items.question: Can I attach a pitch deck or one-pager?
items.answer: Yes, after signing in. Authenticated Lane conversations support images and files as private context.

items.question: What if my event is not configured?
items.answer: Use the future-event waitlist. Lane will preserve the request through sign-in and review it as a future event brief.

waitlist.heading: Bring Lane to the room that matters.
waitlist.body: Tell Lane which future event and city you care about. The request continues as a private introduction brief after sign-in.
waitlist.loginNotice: Sign in to save this future-event introduction request with Lane.

closing.heading: Leave the event with one conversation worth continuing.
closing.body: Build the private brief now. Lane will keep the pool hidden, review the context, and move only with mutual consent.
closing.characterAlt: Lane ready to arrange one careful conference introduction
